Purpose of content policy

In disseminating information on medical institutions and surgical knowledge regarding phimosis treatment, this mediaTo help readers calmly make choices that are appropriate for their own constitution and goals through preliminary examinations and counseling.This policy has been established for the purpose of.

Phimosis treatment is a medical procedure and prescription that is performed under the supervision of a doctor, and it is an essential field to consider such things as restrictions due to health conditions and chronic diseases, side effects and downtime, and cost burden associated with free medical treatment.

Although there is a wide variety of information available on the Web, some of the information may contain expressions that promise excessive changes or lack explanations regarding risks and contractual considerations.

Therefore, in this media,Reliability and neutrality based on public standards and objective factsOur top priority is to provide information that our readers can view and compare with confidence.

Content production and editing policy for phimosis treatment

Based on the characteristics of the medical and healthcare field (YMYL), this media has adopted a responsible editorial policy that complies with related laws and regulations, such as the Medical Advertising Guidelines, Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act, Specified Commercial Transactions Act, and Act on Premiums and Representations.

Thorough user-first and objectivity

In this media,To present options based on objective facts in response to questions and concerns that readers may face when choosing a clinic or considering treatments.is given top priority.

We do more than just provide recommendations, we comprehensively organize and clarify the following information needed when considering a product.

Priority items for information organization
  • Mechanism and characteristics of each treatment (medical/surgical approach)
  • Consultation hours, access, reservation method, and support system of major clinics
  • Expected side effects, risks, downtime and restrictions
  • Costs, additional costs, and early cancellation terms for free medical treatment (related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act)

We add simple explanations for technical terms and use tables and comparison items to ensure high visibility.

References to accurate and reliable sources of information

When writing about medical practices and medicines,Objective evidence published by public institutions and specialized societiesis referring to.

Main references and basis data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical Advertising Guidelines, Pharmaceutical Devices Act, etc.)
  • Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA)
  • Japan Obesity Society, General Incorporated Association
  • Japan Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Independent Administrative Agency National Consumer Affairs Center
  • Officially disclosed information from each medical institution and pharmaceutical manufacturer

Compliance with medical advertising guidelines and related laws and regulations

This media is affiliated with the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare.medical advertising guidelinesYaPharmaceutical device lawBased on this, inappropriate comparisons and inducement expressions are eliminated.

Prohibitions and strict rules regarding expressions
  • Prohibition of absolute/firm expressions:We do not make statements such as ``it will definitely cure'' or ``there is no risk''.
  • Elimination of baseless comparisons and superlative expressions:We do not use descriptions that are not based on objective data, such as "the best," "No. 1," or "best in the industry."
  • Presentation of explanation of unapproved drugs, etc.:When describing drugs that have not been approved in Japan or off-label prescriptions, please include notes regarding acquisition routes and risks.
  • Clarification of contract terms:We present points to note regarding cooling-off and mid-term cancellation conditions based on the Specified Commercial Transactions Act (Specified Continuous Service Provision).

Content production system/quality control flow

In order to provide accurate and reliable phimosis treatment information, our media has established a clear production flow that includes confirmation by experts.

Confirmation by experts/medical personnel

In descriptions regarding medical practices, prescribed drugs, treatment mechanisms, etc.,Content confirmation and supervision by a doctor or medical professionalWe thoroughly check the medical validity and appropriateness of risk explanations.

Content production flow

At this media, we manage the quality of content according to the following process, from planning to post-release operation and information updates.

Content production procedure
  1. Needs survey/issue extraction:A multifaceted analysis of readers' issues (part concerns, budget, convenience of hospital visits, concerns about side effects, etc.)
  2. Configuration design/information verification:Design a structure that covers comparison items, risks, and cancellation conditions based on public materials and officially disclosed information
  3. Writing/legal proofreading:Written in accordance with standards such as medical advertising guidelines, Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act, and Act on Premiums and Representations, excluding expressions of promise.
  4. Medical supervision/fact checking:Professionally checked by a doctor or medical professional to confirm medical validity and considerations.
  5. Regular reviews and information updates:Continuously amend information in accordance with clinic hours, price revisions, and latest guideline revisions, etc.

Regarding advertising and ensuring transparency

This media may include advertisements from affiliated businesses (affiliate programs, etc.) in some articles.

An affiliate program is an advertising system in which when a user uses a service introduced on a website, etc., the operator is compensated according to the results.

References:Affiliate Program│Japan Public Relations Association

The presence or absence of advertisements and the amount of compensation will not unduly distort the clinic's referral content or the fairness of comparisons.

In addition, based on the stealth marketing regulations (required PR notation) under the Act on Premiums and Representations, pages containing advertising space are clearly marked with "PR", etc., to ensure transparency that allows readers to make appropriate decisions.

Disclaimer

The information provided on this media is for the purpose of general commentary and comparison regarding phimosis surgery, and is not intended to replace direct diagnosis, counseling, and treatment by a doctor.

Please be sure to undergo an examination by a doctor at a medical institution before making a decision regarding the suitability of the actual treatment, prescription of medication, and suitability for your constitution.

Although we take care to ensure the accuracy and up-to-dateness of published information, the treatment content and fee structure of each clinic are subject to change. Please be sure to check each clinic's official website directly for the latest information.
